objective: separately labelled continuously advancing normal-game MAP01 Astra hero attempt
observations: visible X11 frames only; 2x2 temporal sheet, newest three prior decision sources plus current source
actions: shared X11 OS keyboard input through semantic command compiler; no action vector
time_rule: game continues during model calls; no pause, save state, automap, labels or hidden state for controller
local_reaction: command-effect receipt threshold <=0.015 and model-authored no-visible-effect contingency; bundle only at contingency boundaries
stop_rule: retain the single allocation at model-declared death/exit-transition, 56 decisions, runtime failure, or independent episode timeout; no rerun
scoring: independent post-control MAP01 exit, death count, kill count and one-life exit; controller does not receive scorer state
interpretation: clear may be used as hero evidence; any unfinished/death/failure remains retained and does not block Research Preview; no model-identity causality claim
required_post_record: full report, usage, source frames, runtime events/environment/score, branch receipts, failures and reconstructable video or frame-timed visual record
